I have implemented the `BatchDurable` event callback, durability tracking, and wait APIs in Pebble on branch `durable-writes`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`EventListener.BatchDurable` Callback**:
   - Added [`BatchDurable func(BatchDurableInfo)`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/event.go#L953) to `EventListener`.
   - Defined [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/event.go#L81-L104) carrying `JobID`, `SeqNum`, `Err`, `ApplyDuration`, `SyncDuration`, `CorrelationID`, `BatchSize`, and `KeyCount`.
   - Wired through [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/event.go#L1259-L1262), `EventListener.EnsureDefaults`, and `MakeLoggingEventListener`.
   - Fires exactly once per sync commit after the WAL sync completes, even on failure. Non-sync commits and `DisableWAL` do not trigger it.

2. **`WriteOptions` & Experimental Options**:
   - Added `CommitCorrelationID uint64` to [`WriteOptions`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/options.go#L408-L411).
   - Added `DurabilityJobRetentionWindow int` and `MaxDurabilitySubscriptions int` to `Options.Experimental` ([options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/options.go#L614-L621)).

3. **Durability Manager & DB APIs**:
   - Implemented in [`durability.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go):
     - [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L277) / [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L284): blocks until a sequence number is durable; seqNum 0 succeeds after any commit.
     - [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L369) / [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L375): blocks until every sequence number in slice is durable; nil/empty slice returns nil immediately.
     - [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L399) / [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L405): waits by callback job ID. Jobs outside the retention window return an error containing `"expired"`; never-seen or zero IDs return an error containing `"unknown"`.
     - [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L483): returns highest durable sequence number and first latched error.
     - [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L495): returns a pre-filled receive-only channel bounded by `MaxDurabilitySubscriptions`. Excess callers receive an immediate non-nil error.
     - [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability.go#L540): returns snapshot of stats (`HighestDurableSeqNum`, `FirstErr`, `PendingWaiters`, `TotalDurableCommits`, `TotalFailedCommits`, `CumulativeSyncDuration`, `MaxSyncDuration`).
   - In all context variants, durability and close errors take precedence over context cancellation.
   - All waiters unblock with `ErrClosed` on DB close.
   - When `DisableWAL` is true, wait APIs and `DurabilityNotify` return nil immediately.

4. **Metrics**:
   - Added `DurableCommitCount uint64` and `DurableCommitDuration time.Duration` to [`Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/metrics.go#L206-L213), accumulated only when `BatchDurable` is configured.

5. **Testing**:
   - Comprehensive test suite in [`durability_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-iztamf1l/durability_test.go) verifying callback parameters, non-sync and `DisableWAL` gating, wait APIs, job retention expiration/unknown handling, bounded subscriptions, context cancellation precedence, stats, unblocking on close, and WAL sync failure handling. All tests pass with `-tags invariants`.
